# tabdo Docs

> An AI-native workspace for personal plans and small team projects. Use the guides to organize information, take action, and review results.
> Fetch this index before exploring further.

## Welcome
- [Welcome](https://tabdo.ai/docs/welcome): Bring a personal plan or small team project; organize information, take action, and adjust the result.
- [From an idea to the next step](https://tabdo.ai/docs/how-it-works): Describe a goal, organize what you know, review the result, and choose what to do next.

## Agents
- [Choose a model and run mode](https://tabdo.ai/docs/harness): Choose from available models and run modes in your workspace.
- [Create and manage agents](https://tabdo.ai/docs/agent-auth): Create agents, edit settings, and review workspace permissions.

## For people
- [Getting started](https://tabdo.ai/docs/human-quickstart): Choose a workspace and agent, organize information, add records, and review results.
- [HTTP API](https://tabdo.ai/docs/api-quickstart): Discover tables, paginate records, and manage records with per-table tab_ permissions.
- [Tables, columns, and records](https://tabdo.ai/docs/tables): Create columns, enter records, and use files, relations, rollups, and formulas.
- [Views and boards](https://tabdo.ai/docs/views): Create grid, board, and form views; filter, sort, and review records.
- [Forms](https://tabdo.ai/docs/forms): Design a data entry view and review submissions in the same table.
- [Automations and scheduled tasks](https://tabdo.ai/docs/automations): Trigger agent and data actions from table changes, webhooks, email, or a schedule.
- [Event sources: AgentMail and Webhook](https://tabdo.ai/docs/integrations): Configure email or HTTP event sources and review their automation results.
- [Reports](https://tabdo.ai/docs/reports): Summarize workspace tables with metrics, charts, and text.
- [Sites](https://tabdo.ai/docs/sites): Edit HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files, preview changes, and publish a site version.

## Concepts and references
- [Data access and permissions](https://tabdo.ai/docs/architecture): Understand workspace roles and per-table data access keys.
- [Workspace members](https://tabdo.ai/docs/members): Review roles and invite workspace members.
- [Data REST API](https://tabdo.ai/docs/rest): Table metadata, paginated reads, and record CRUD routes.
- [GraphQL API](https://tabdo.ai/docs/graphql): GraphQL queries, pagination, mutations, and limits.
- [JavaScript / TypeScript SDK](https://tabdo.ai/docs/sdk): Install and use the published @tabdo/sdk package.
- [Authentication](https://tabdo.ai/docs/auth): Use your tabdo account for workspace features and tab_ keys for authorized table data.
